findings.impact: The Markdown report and progress receipt classify independent review as NOT_RUN, while the JSON manifest and four committed schema-valid role reviews record ROUND_1_NOT_CLEAN. This makes the checkpoint's adversarial-review status internally inconsistent and understates recorded failures.
findings.minimal_fix: Change the Markdown report and progress receipt to ROUND_1_NOT_CLEAN, identify the four committed reviews, and retain re-review as an open gate.

findings.impact: The GitHub/Discord delivery receipt binds commit 7a9999f and attachment hashes b58ec3bc/1fc8c2ba, but current HEAD changed both delivered artifacts to hashes 391a4f0a/c53d116b. Therefore the durable receipt proves delivery only of the superseded report and manifest, not the corrected current checkpoint.
findings.minimal_fix: Publish and deliver the corrected HEAD artifacts, then commit the new publication commit, issue-comment identifier, message identifier, byte counts, and SHA-256 hashes.
